title: Mission changes reach open views live; the Topic survives a reload; the narrow Missions header stays readable
user_story: As the owner I want a mission an agent creates to appear without a reload, the selected Topic to survive a reload, and the Missions header to stay readable in a narrow drawer (live run 2026-10-28; agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md A8).

requirements.description: Creation, approval, cancellation, retry and step review publish research.mission {mission_id, topic_id, status} after the write; a refused change publishes nothing; the UI bus also refreshes the Workflows L1–L4 panel.

nonfunctional: Bus events carry ids and status only
acceptance_criteria: UI (Topic remembered per project folder and restored only if it still exists; Missions header wraps its mode switch below the title): missions_live.spec.ts 4/4 (live mission, Topic reload, narrow drawers at 1024/1280 px); topicMemory.test.ts and useAppBus.test.tsx pass

scenarios.expected: draft, queued and cancelled are published with mission and topic id
No event for a change that did not happen
Events carry ids and status only

recovery: Fix at missions._announce / the UI store; never publish mission content on the bus. TASK-MISSIONS-LIVE-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR (tests/_env.py) for the backend; disposable QA server and Playwright for the UI; evidence in docs/qa/evidence/missions-live-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 5 tests on 981b7fc, 3 failing (no event on create/approve/cancel/review) and the content test erroring; the refusal and timing checks pass on both. GREEN: 5/5.
